Please follow below steps and ensure your safety as you visit:
While checking the SPD fuse FC1, also inspect FA1 for any loose power wires, ensuring the grey connector underneath the SPD is properly connected. Verify that all connections on the terminal match the configuration shown below.
Check for the connector and fuses of SPD.
For connector, Check for FA1 Plug - FA1:11 and FA1:12. Check if it is receiving 24V.
Then for Fuses, check whether FC1.1, FC1.2 and FC1.3 are connected appropriately and check the continuity.
As shown in the picture above, if the inspection window is RED, then we need to replace SPD.
Please carry along the spare fuses and a surge protection device with you.
